title: fix(cxf): upgrade cxf-rt-rs-security-oauth2 to 4.2.2.vendor-00001 and block authorization-code replay (CVE-2026-68079)
commit_message:
fix(cxf): block authorization-code replay CVE-2026-68079

Upgrade org.apache.cxf from 4.2.2 to vendor backport 4.2.2.vendor-00001.
DefaultEncryptingCodeDataProvider allowed unlimited replay of a captured
authorization code; the backport corrects removeCodeGrant() to return null
on any reuse attempt, satisfying RFC 6749 section 4.1.2.

Both artifacts governed by ${cxf.version} (cxf-rt-rs-security-oauth2 and
cxf-spring-boot-starter-jaxrs) are published at the backport version, so
the single-property change leaves no dependency unresolvable.

Remove the fallback return branch in AuditedCodeDataProvider.removeCodeGrant()
that re-returned the grant from the local audit map when super returned null.
That branch would have restored the replayed code to the caller and defeated
the library fix entirely.

Add AuditedCodeDataProviderTest#authorizationCodeCannotBeRedeemedMoreThanOnce.
The test failed against the vulnerable code and passes after both changes.
End-to-end HTTP replay was not covered.
